runner.install_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential clang cmake ninja-build pkg-config python3 python3-pytest && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
runner.env_probe_command: printf '%s\n' '#include <hrefparse.h>' '#include <cstdlib>' '#include <iostream>' '#include <string>' 'int main() { const std::string input = std::string("https:") + "//127.0.0.1/path"; auto url = hrefparse::parse(input); if (!url) return EXIT_FAILURE; if (url->get_hostname() != "127.0.0.1") return EXIT_FAILURE; if (url->get_pathname() != "/path") return EXIT_FAILURE; std::cout << url->get_href() << std::endl; return EXIT_SUCCESS; }' > /tmp/cb-env-probe.cpp && c++ -std=c++20 -pthread -Iinclude -Lbuild/src -Lbuild -o /tmp/cb-env-probe /tmp/cb-env-probe.cpp -lhrefparse && /tmp/cb-env-probe
